waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: Dry to touch does not mean ready for tiles, traffic or water. Waterproofing and tiling involve separate waiting stages, each tied to the selected materials and actual conditions. Ask for a staged programme and clear return-to-use instructions for your job rather than relying on a general number of hours.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 摸起来干燥，不代表可以贴砖、踩踏或接触水。防水与贴砖涉及不同等待阶段，分别取决于选定材料及现场条件。请索取本项目分阶段安排与明确恢复使用说明，不依赖笼统小时数。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: There is no universal number of hours for these stages. Use the selected materials and actual site conditions to confirm the programme.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 这些阶段没有统一小时数，应按所选材料和实际现场条件确认安排。
现场条件与材料养护要求

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: Temperature, humidity, ventilation and substrate condition can affect drying and curing. A cool enclosed bathroom may behave differently from a ventilated room. Moisture in the base, material compatibility and the specified application also matter. Extra heat or forced drying should not be assumed suitable without the relevant instructions.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 温度、湿度、通风和基层状况影响干燥养护。低温封闭浴室可能与通风房间不同。基层水分、材料兼容和指定施工方式也重要，未核对相关说明前，不应假定加热或强制干燥合适。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: Preparation discovered after removal can add stages before waterproofing begins. Repairs to damp or damaged lining need to be resolved first. Plan around the actual base and selected materials, including any required inspection or testing, rather than adding one universal waiting period to every job.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 拆除后发现的准备工作，可能在防水前增加工序；潮湿或损坏墙衬需先修复。应围绕实际基层和材料规划所需检查或测试，而非给每项工程增加同一等待期。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: Use the instructions for the selected system

Ask which waterproofing, adhesive, grout and sealant are specified and how their instructions fit together. Readiness should be confirmed for those products and site conditions. Do not transfer a waiting time from another brand, a different product or an unrelated project.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 请确认指定防水、瓷砖胶、填缝及密封胶，以及各产品说明如何衔接。应按这些产品和现场条件确认就绪，不套用其他品牌、产品或无关项目的等待时间。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: distinguishes recoating, readiness for tiling and full cure under stated conditions. It demonstrates that the stages differ; it does not identify the product selected for your job or set its schedule.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 在特定条件下区分重涂、可贴砖及完全固化，说明阶段不同；并不表示您的项目使用该产品，也不决定本项目工期。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: Agree a staged programme before work
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 开工前确认分阶段安排

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: A useful programme identifies preparation and any base repairs, waterproofing stages, readiness for tiling, adhesive and joint finishing, then the restrictions before use. Agree who confirms each stage and how changes will be communicated. Required checks and testing belong in the job-specific plan, with timing based on the selected system.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 有效安排应列出准备及基层维修、防水阶段、贴砖就绪、瓷砖胶与接缝收尾，以及使用限制。确认各阶段由谁验收、如何沟通变更。必要检查和测试应纳入项目计划，按系统安排时间。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: For an occupied home, identify alternative shower or room access and the earliest safe point for each intended use.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 仍有人居住时，应确认替代淋浴或房间通道，以及各用途最早安全恢复时间。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: Handover and returning to normal use

Ask for clear instructions covering the agreed return to foot traffic, loads, cleaning and water exposure. If conditions delay a stage, confirm the revised instructions before using the area. Do not test readiness by walking on new tiles or running the shower.
waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.target: 请索取明确的踩踏、载荷、清洁及接触水恢复说明。条件导致延期时，使用前确认更新要求，不用走上新砖或淋浴放水测试就绪。

waterproofing-drying-curing-guide.html/h.source: Tell us your suburb, the work area and its current condition. Safely taken photos and available material details can help the discussion; you can enquire without photographs or measurements. We assess the job before confirming a written scope.
